comment: PRIMARY online backend: Cornell Google Drive via Google Apps Script (tools/gas_drive_backend.js). adapter=gas POSTs text/plain to endpoint with the shared study token. Lab mode with tools/server.py also best-effort POSTs to /api/save (local disk) in addition to Drive. Do not put a Google password, Box credential, or service-account key here. The token is a study password visible in the client; it only blocks casual misuse. IRB should confirm de-identified data may be stored in Cornell Google Drive (Sensitive / Moderate Risk).
